seo_title: B2B Video SEO: Dominate YouTube and Google | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Make your corporate videos profitable. We optimize your audiovisual assets to dominate the second largest search engine and capture B2B clients.
author_pitch: I've seen companies spend thousands of dollars producing top-quality corporate videos that die with barely 15 views. I apply SEO engineering to rescue those audiovisual assets and turn them into recurring lead generation machines on YouTube and Google.
title: The forgotten search engine: Make your B2B videos profitable and dominate YouTube
body:
Does your company invest thousands of dollars in recording software demos or corporate videos that end up accumulating barely twenty views?

Audiovisual content is the most persuasive sales tool in the B2B sector, capable of explaining complex technical processes in a matter of minutes. However, many companies spend fortunes on specialized production agencies, record masterful webinars or high-level technical tutorials, upload them to their corporate channel, and there they die. You are completely ignoring the second largest search engine in the world: YouTube. If your corporate clients are looking for how to solve an industrial problem or integrate software, they prefer to watch a practical video rather than read a dense fifty-page manual. By not optimizing this material for the algorithms, you are burying a very expensive investment and letting your competition, with much lower quality videos, steal all the visual attention and the million-dollar contracts.

The trap of Uploading and Praying

Uploading a video with a generic title like "Corporate Demo 2024" and leaving the description blank is digital suicide. The algorithm doesn't have eyes; it needs to read structured text metadata to understand the context of your content. A spectacular video without SEO optimization is like broadcasting a Super Bowl commercial on a turned-off television channel.

Our solution: SEO Optimization for Video Assets

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we rescue your audiovisual material from oblivion. We apply deep technical markup and restructure the metadata of your assets so they dominate both native YouTube results and the visual carousels on the first page of Google.

  1. Video Schema Markup: We inject invisible structured code into your website so Google correctly indexes the embedded videos, understanding exactly the topic, author, and duration.
  2. Metadata and Transcription Optimization: We rewrite titles, tags, and descriptions based on transactional keywords, and upload precise closed captions (CC) so the algorithm crawls every word spoken by your experts.
  3. Key Moments Implementation: We fragment your long videos into timestamped chapters, allowing corporate executives to skip directly to the technical solution they are looking for and dominating video featured snippets.
  4. B2B Linking Synergy: We strategically connect your video channel's authority with your main service pages (Landing Pages), creating a visual conversion funnel that redirects viewers from YouTube toward direct quote requests.

The Real Impact on your Content Strategy

  • Audiovisual Return on Investment: You quickly amortize production costs by getting your demonstrations and tutorials seen by thousands of decision-makers over the years.
  • Search Results Monopoly: Your brand will dominate both traditional text links and large rich video carousels, physically pushing your competition off the first page.
  • Sales Cycle Acceleration: A corporate client who has consumed your educational videos arrives at the first sales meeting much more educated, convinced of your technical authority, and ready to close the contract.
